question: The ICMR-NIN 2020 protein RDA of 0.83 g/kg/day applies only to non-vegetarian individuals; vegetarians require a higher protein allowance.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is false. The ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA of 0.83 g/kg/day applies regardless of dietary pattern. Vegetarians achieve adequate amino acid profiles through complementary proteins.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: This is actually false. The 0.83 g/kg/day RDA applies to all dietary patterns. Vegetarians can meet requirements through complementary proteins (cereals + pulses); a separate RDA is not specified.
